title: Cleaner mobile workflow
summary: Fixes narrow-screen staffing cards and removes duplicated information from Breaks.
changes: Fixes overtime cards on narrow phones so nurse names no longer collapse into letter-by-letter wrapping.
Moves overtime role status beneath the nurse details so names, role badges and actions remain easy to scan.
Removes the duplicated Absences and Labour Ward summary from Breaks so the screen focuses on the rest plan.
Keeps Night, Changes and Breaks focused on current plan, staffing changes and rest planning respectively.
